Q3_contrast_memory.pattern: Absolute-rate memory goes stale under level shifts (OR-TS 2026: level varies 25x more than contrast); contrast/sliding memory ends on better arm 2x more often.

Q4_exp3_tail.pattern: Exp3-IX halves the P95-P50 tail vs Exp3 (Thm12.1); expectation hides variance.
